description: Read the listing automation of a one-item-per-listing marketplace (Vinted), where a sale ends the listing: whether it lists the next unit after a sale and again when stock arrives, when (relistTiming: instant, next_run within 10 minutes, after_1h, after_6h, after_24h), its publishing windows in the workspace time zone, the daily limit, the refresh of listings that do not sell, the settings version, whether a dry run was done (previewAt), whether the connection's own publishing and removing are turned on (arming — only the owner turns those on, on the connection page), and the queue summary (open jobs by state, listed today, failed this week). Read-only. Use update_listing_automation to change it, preview_listing_automation for the dry run, list_listing_jobs for the queue itself.

platform.description: The marketplace whose listing automation this is. Only vinted has one today.
